setup: Current preview only; CN/variable, literal-entry OFF, ID legends. Every case Clear, no modifiers, type digits 12. Direct Ctrl+M12 sends Ctrl+a and selects 12; Alt+M12 is refused. Shift+either modifier+M12 carries shifted ASCII ], so both Ctrl and Alt paths are refused. Follow with digit 3 to verify selection replacement or modifier consumption. Do not switch EN or use top SelectAll.
